article.heading: License
article.lead: Aethyr is free. Use it for anything, including commercial games and tools. The one condition is that you credit Doug Fessler when you ship.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.html:
Aethyr is the MCP server, the editor plugin and the documentation. It's free forever, for any purpose, commercial or not. You can use it, copy it, change it, share it and sell things made with it. There are no tiers, no fees and no license keys.

This page is a plain summary. The full text is short. If this page and the license text differ, the text governs.

sections.heading: The one condition: credit Doug Fessler
sections.html:
If you ship or distribute Aethyr, or any product that includes it or was made with its help, credit Doug Fessler somewhere reasonable in that product. This covers a game, a tool, a plugin, or any project built with Aethyr. This line is enough:

Aethyr by Doug Fessler (https://aethyr.gg)

Good places for it:

  • your credits roll,
  • an About screen,
  • your documentation,
  • your README.

sections.heading: Keep the notice
sections.html: Keep the copyright notice and the permission notice in all copies or substantial portions of the software. That's the second and last condition.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.html: Aethyr is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. The authors and copyright holders aren't liable for any claim, damages or other liability that comes from using it. Aethyr can read and change project files, so keep your project in source control and use the built-in backup feature. See Security & Privacy for what the backup feature does.

sections.heading: Third-party notices
sections.html:
The Aethyr editor plugin (the modules under Source/) contains only first-party code and depends on Unreal Engine modules. The MCP server executable vendors these libraries, as listed in NOTICE.md, which carries their license texts:

  • nlohmann/json, MIT. JSON-RPC wire format, server only.
  • fmt, MIT. String formatting, server only.
  • BLAKE3, CC0-1.0 (or Apache-2.0). Checksum of the editor's asset gather cache, server only.
  • doctest, MIT. Unit tests, server only, not shipped.

sections.heading: Full text
sections.html: The same text ships as LICENSE.md in every download (Plugins/Aethyr/LICENSE.md once unzipped). You can also read the copy this website uses: LICENSE on GitHub.

sections.heading: This website and its brand assets
sections.html: This website's pages, styles and brand assets use the same Aethyr License as the software, with the same single condition. Credit Doug Fessler with the line above and keep the notice. Reweave, ImGui Studio and Slate Studio are separate products and carry their own terms.

sections.heading: Brand
sections.html:
This is optional style guidance. It isn't a term of the license. The only requirement is the credit above. If you'd like Aethyr to look consistent wherever it appears, this is how we set it.

Wordmark

The name is set in IM Fell DW Pica, uppercase, with wide letter-spacing: Aethyr. Keep it one word with a capital A, and please don't translate, abbreviate, or rename it.

  • Do keep the credit legible and the link intact.
  • Do place the wordmark on a dark ground for contrast.
  • Don't recolour the wordmark into a gradient, add glow or effects, or re-letterspace it.
  • Don't imply endorsement or partnership beyond the credit itself.

sections.heading: Colour & type
sections.html:
Aethyr is a void ground with four accents. Each accent carries a meaning in the product UI — reuse the coding if you extend it.

  • Cerulean #2fb9ff — primary accent · read
  • Magenta #ff2bd6 — write
  • Violet #9b6bff — batch
  • Ember #ff8a4c — safety & caution
  • Void #0b0c1a — background
  • Ink #e8ecff — text

Typefaces

  • IM Fell DW Pica — display & wordmark
  • Chakra Petch — labels, UI, small caps
  • Sora — body text
  • JetBrains Mono — code & data
